title: Preliminary competitor scorecard for E.ON Czech retail energy
market: Czech retail electricity and gas supply
status: Directional hypotheses only; not a verified, evidence-based ranking

scale.2: Below average / limited evidence of strength
scale.NA: Not enough reliable evidence to score

methodology: Scores are preliminary analyst hypotheses based on general public positioning and the starter competitor matrix, not measured market data. They are relative to the listed Czech retail competitors, not absolute performance scores. No weighted total is calculated. Validate each score against current official sources and comparable metrics before using it for decisions.

market_footprint.rationale: Broad national presence and incumbent scale; verify retail customer and delivered-volume data.

tariff_competitiveness_transparency.rationale: Large portfolio suggests broad choice, but no like-for-like current tariff comparison was performed.

customer_segment_coverage.rationale: Appears to serve household, SME, business and public-sector segments; validate by product availability.

brand_trust_service_quality.rationale: High brand visibility is not the same as measured trust or service quality; verify with surveys and complaint data.

digital_experience.rationale: Large-scale customer operations likely support digital self-service; benchmark task completion and customer feedback.

green_energy_offering.rationale: Renewable generation and green products are part of the group profile; compare retail product claims and guarantees.

regulatory_adaptation.rationale: Large integrated incumbent likely has substantial compliance capability; no implementation audit conducted.

vertical_integration.rationale: Group spans generation, distribution-related activities and retail; check current legal-entity boundaries and market roles.

partnerships_ma_activity.rationale: Scale and infrastructure activity suggest meaningful partnership and investment capacity; assess current deals individually.

public_signals_hiring.rationale: A systematic, dated news and vacancies sample has not been collected; do not infer hiring momentum.

limitations: These are directional starting scores, not verified market facts or an investment recommendation.
Most company-level scores have low confidence because no comparable primary-source evidence set was collected.
NA means do not score until evidence is collected; it must not be interpreted as poor performance.
No overall winner or aggregate score is provided because dimensions are not yet weighted and evidence quality varies.
Use the same reference date, customer profile and evidence standard across all suppliers before publishing a final benchmark.
